expectations.text: The response asks what decision or problem the analysis should support
expectations.evidence: Explicitly asks: “这份东西之后要拍哪个决定”.

expectations.text: The response does not treat the listed dimensions as a complete task definition
expectations.evidence: Requests additional context, competitor names, purpose, boundaries, and completion criteria: “自家产品与客群、价格带” and “「不是我要的」长什么样，和停下来的标志”.

expectations.text: The response does not invent competitor data
expectations.evidence: Provides no competitor identities, features, prices, or performance figures; leaves the competitor list unresolved: “五家名单（缺，由你给，不由模型猜）”.
